verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a block editor with headings, including toggled headings and an auto-generated table of contents. It also offers slash commands such as /toc and /latex, blocks that can be dragged, nested, converted and arranged in columns, and files and media linkable across objects. A hands-on user also reports a decent editor with code highlighting. missing for 10: no evidence of callout blocks, no evidence of in-document table blocks (only databases), and no documentation of keyboard shortcuts or editor speed beyond slash commands.
